column1: # name: LoRaWAN regional channel plans: the rows that make the channels of each plan
# note: Each row makes count channels from first_mhz
column3: of width_khz and the spreading factors sf_min to sf_max. uplink: devices send there; downlink: gateways answer there (inverted IQ); default: a default (join) channel. A row with sub_band_size divides its channels into sub-bands of that many
column5: and a host that keeps one sub-band keeps only those of that sub-band; other rows stay. A row with uplink 0 is a channel for downlinks only. A host gives the stack the channels in its setting lw_channels as frequency Hz/bandwidth Hz/sf_min-sf_max/flags entries
